answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service to build durable trust; brief activity cannot manufacture history. In EigenTrust factorization, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths, while reciprocal endorsements among sybils contribute little under reciprocity-weighted transitivity. Their mutual praise is an echo in a lagoon, not evidence of trust: an ivory badge cannot make them pass consensus.
